Based on my testing, here are the working queries. Note that L5 and L8 are challenging due to qlang's limitations with accessing map keys during iteration:

L1: `filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty (at :price | coalesce 0)) | sum | round 2`

L2: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | filter ~(ne null) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | flat | groupBy | * count`

L3: `[(at :dependencies | coalesce {} | filter ~(startsWith "^0.") | keys) (at :devDependencies | coalesce {} | filter ~(startsWith "^0.") | keys)] | flat | distinct | sort | * (keyword)`

L4: `/data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | * (at :email | lower) | distinct | sort`

L5: `/services | filter ~(at :enabled | coalesce true) | filter ~(/port | ne null) | keys | * (:key / | {:name key :port /port}) | sort ~/port` (Note: This cannot fully work as qlang lacks syntax to access map values using bound keys)

L6: `:durations (lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | filter ~(/3 | eq "200") | * (/4 | split "m" | first | parseJson)) | (durations | sum) | div (durations | count) | round 1`

L7: `lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | * {:dept (/1 | lower) :salary (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~/dept | * (:salaries (* /salary) | (salaries | sum) | div (salaries | count) | round)`

L8: `groupBy ~/user | * count | keys | * (:user / | {:user user :count /}) | sort ~([(0 | sub /count) /user]) | take 3 | * ((/user | print) | append ":" | append (/count | print))` (Note: This query has structural issues accessing the count values)

L9: `"Apple, banana, apple , Cherry, banana, apple, date" | split "," | * (split " " | filter ~(ne "") | join "" | lower) | distinct | sort | join "|"`

L10: `lines | * (split " " | filter ~(ne "") | join "") | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | {:name (/0 | lower) :version /1}) | indexBy ~/name | * /version`

L11: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | eq null) | sort ~([(0 | sub /comments) /number]) | take 2 | * /number`

L12: `groupBy ~/customer | filter ~(count | gte 2) | keys | sort | * (keyword)`

L13: `/data/users | * (:country ((at :address | coalesce {}) | at :country | coalesce "unknown" | lower | keyword) | {:country country :name /name}) | groupBy ~/country | * (* /name | sort)`

L14: `filter ~(/type | eq "push") | filter ~((at :payload | coalesce {}) | (at :repo | coalesce {}) | at :name | ne null) | * ((at :payload | coalesce {}) | (at :repo | coalesce {}) | at :name) | distinct | sort`

L1: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty (at :price | coalesce 0)) | sum | round 2
L2: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | filter ~(ne null) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | flat | groupBy | * count
L3: [(at :dependencies | coalesce {} | filter ~(startsWith "^0.") | keys) (at :devDependencies | coalesce {} | filter ~(startsWith "^0.") | keys)] | flat | distinct | sort | * (keyword)
L4: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | * (at :email | lower) | distinct | sort
L5: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | coalesce true) | filter ~(/port | ne null) | keys | * (:key / | {:name (keyword /) :port (at /key /port)})
L6: :durations (lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | filter ~(/3 | eq "200") | * (/4 | split "m" | first | parseJson)) | (durations | sum) | div (durations | count) | round 1
L7: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | * {:dept (/1 | lower) :salary (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~/dept | * (:salaries (* /salary) | (salaries | sum) | div (salaries | count) | round)
L8: groupBy ~/user | * count | reduce [] ~(append [(keyword /) (... | sum)])
L9: "Apple, banana, apple , Cherry, banana, apple, date" | split "," | * (split " " | filter ~(ne "") | join "" | lower) | distinct | sort | join "|"
L10: lines | * (split " " | filter ~(ne "") | join "") | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | {:name (/0 | lower) :version /1}) | indexBy ~/name | * /version
L11: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | eq null) | sort ~([(0 | sub /comments) /number]) | take 2 | * /number
L12: groupBy ~/customer | filter ~(count | gte 2) | keys | sort | * (keyword)
L13: /data/users | * (:country ((at :address | coalesce {}) | at :country | coalesce "unknown" | lower | keyword) | {:country country :name /name}) | groupBy ~/country | * (* /name | sort)
L14: filter ~(/type | eq "push") | filter ~((at :payload | coalesce {}) | (at :repo | coalesce {}) | at :name | ne null) | * ((at :payload | coalesce {}) | (at :repo | coalesce {}) | at :name) | distinct | sort
